{
  "dataset_name": "adult_income",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [-1.64, 3.87],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents the age feature from dominating Euclidean distance calculations due to its larger raw scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 38.7095) / 13.2894"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_per_week_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized hours per week for balanced distance metrics.",
      "value_range": [-3.35, 4.87],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the variance of working hours, improving the geometry of the KNN neighborhood.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(hours_per_week - 40.9395) / 11.9305"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_num_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized education years.",
      "value_range": [-3.56, 2.28],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures education level contributes proportionally to similarity scores without overshadowing other features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education_num - 10.1435) / 2.5705"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_net_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed net capital gain to compress extreme outliers and improve distance scaling.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.52],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the impact of massive capital gains on distance metrics, preventing isolated points from distorting neighborhoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(capital_gain - capital_loss, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_average_worker",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the unsupervised global mean profile of age, hours per week, and education.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.5],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous measure of typicality, allowing the model to easily group average individuals versus outliers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((age - 38.7095) / 13.2894)**2 + ((hours_per_week - 40.9395) / 11.9305)**2 + ((education_num - 10.1435) / 2.5705)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_full_time_prime_age",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for individuals in their prime working years working full-time or more.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a distinct hypercube region in the feature space, helping KNN quickly identify a major demographic cluster.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((hours_per_week >= 40) & (age >= 25) & (age <= 55), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_volatility_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for any non-zero capital gain or loss.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates individuals with active investments from those without, creating a useful categorical split for distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((capital_gain > 0) | (capital_loss > 0), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "work_intensity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A composite score multiplying normalized hours and age, clipped to prevent extreme values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the interaction between age and working hours, providing a dense, continuous feature for similarity matching.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((hours_per_week / 40.0) * (age / 38.7), 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "career_stage_similarity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how closely the individual's profile matches a typical mid-career professional based on age, education, and occupation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, semantic similarity gradient that raw Euclidean distance on categorical variables cannot capture.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "socioeconomic_status_proxy",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of socioeconomic status derived from the combination of occupation, education, and workclass.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Projects multiple categorical variables into a single ordinal dimension, significantly improving distance metrics for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "family_structure_complexity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of family structure complexity based on marital_status and relationship codes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates nominal relationship categories into a meaningful ordinal scale, reducing the sparsity of the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_prototype_distance",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of the distance to the most frequent unsupervised demographic profile (native country, race, sex).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a continuous spatial anchor, allowing the model to measure how demographically typical or atypical a row is.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
